## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Type of change

- [ ] UI / visual improvement
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Maintenance / dependency update
- [ ] Security or accessibility improvement

## Testing

- [ ] Relevant lint checks pass.
- [ ] Type checks pass, if configured.
- [ ] Production build passes.
- [ ] Relevant user flow tested.
- [ ] Mobile layout reviewed.
- [ ] Keyboard navigation and visible focus reviewed.

## UI evidence

Add screenshots or a recording for visible changes. Use approved project assets only.

## Data and configuration

- [ ] No secrets or private customer data added.
- [ ] Environment variable changes documented.
- [ ] Data or migration changes documented.
- [ ] Third-party licence and attribution obligations checked.

## Reviewer notes

List any known limitations, follow-up work, or decisions needed.
